definitions.explanation: A castle in Himeji, Hyogo Prefecture, with a white-walled main keep that survives from the early 1600s. A National Treasure and, since 1993, one of Japan's first World Heritage Sites.

notes:
Japan's best-known castle. Many castle keeps, such as that of {大阪城|おおさかじょう}, are modern concrete reconstructions; {姫路城|ひめじじょう} is an original wooden keep, which is why it is so often held up as the model Japanese castle.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {白鷺城|はくろじょう} / {白鷺城|しらさぎじょう}: "White Heron Castle", its nickname from the white plaster walls
- ⟦{世界遺産|せかいいさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姫路城|ひめじじょう}: Himeji Castle, the World Heritage Site

CULTURAL NOTE:
A frequent setting for period dramas and films, and a standard stop on school trips and tours of the Kansai region.
